# htmltools.me AI API

> OpenAI-compatible chat completions gateway on Cloudflare Workers. Free shared pool
> on Cloudflare Workers AI, plus an optional bring-your-own-key path for Groq. This
> file is written for AI agents and tools that need a compact, accurate description.

Base URL: https://htmltools-me-ai-api.bozhetarnikmatthew.workers.dev/v1
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer ht-...` (keys are created at https://htmltools.me/AI-API/Dashboard/)
Response format: OpenAI `chat.completion` / `chat.completion.chunk` / error envelope
Human docs: https://htmltools.me/AI-API/Docs/
OpenAPI: https://htmltools.me/AI-API/openapi.json

## Endpoints

GET  /v1/models
     Lists only the model ids this gateway accepts, with an `x_ht` extension carrying
     provider, availability, streaming/tool support and output caps.
     Requires a valid key. Does not consume daily quota.

POST /v1/chat/completions
     Body: { model, messages, stream?, max_tokens?, temperature?, top_p?, stop?,
             tools?, tool_choice?, response_format?, stream_options? }
     Supported message roles: system, user, assistant, tool. `developer` becomes `system`.
     Text content only: image_url and audio parts are rejected with `unsupported_content`.
     `n` must be 1. `logprobs` are rejected. 1-40 messages, 128 KB body ceiling.

GET  /health            Readiness: status ready|degraded, missing[], fixes{}. No AI work.
GET  /public/status     Pool remaining, request counts, model list. No auth, no AI work.
POST /siloai/chat       SiloAI, the in-site assistant. Requires a Firebase ID token, not an API key.
                        (POST /htsilo/chat still answers, deprecated.)

## Models (allowlist)

Free pool (Workers AI):
  @cf/meta/llama-3.2-3b-instruct                 max output 768,  tools: no
  @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct                 max output 1024, tools: yes  (default)
  @cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast       max output 1024, tools: yes  (expensive)
  auto                                            resolves to a free model, or the Groq model when a key is connected

Bring your own Groq key (only when the account has connected one):
  llama-3.1-8b-instant
  llama-3.3-70b-versatile
  openai/gpt-oss-20b
  openai/gpt-oss-120b
  qwen/qwen3-32b
  meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct

Any other model id returns 400 `model_not_found`.

## Limits (documented defaults)

  10 requests/minute per key
  10 requests/minute per account
  60 requests/minute site-wide
  150 free-pool requests/day per account
  1,200 free-pool requests/day site-wide
  6,000 Neurons/day free-pool budget site-wide
  2,000 requests/day per account when using your own Groq key
  Resets at 00:00 UTC.

## Error codes

  401 invalid_api_key | key_revoked
  400 model_not_found | provider_not_connected | unsupported_content |
      unsupported_parameter | unsupported_feature | context_length_exceeded |
      invalid_request
  403 reauth_required
  404 not_found
  409 key_not_recoverable
  413 request_too_large
  429 rate_limit_exceeded | site_rate_limit | free_pool_exhausted | user_daily_limit
  502 upstream_error | provider_error

Error body: {"error":{"message":string,"type":string,"param":null|string,"code":string}}
429 responses carry Retry-After in seconds.

## Behaviour notes

- The shared free pool stops at its daily cap; it never falls back to a paid provider.
- Streaming is server-sent events ending with `data: [DONE]`.
- Tool calling is available only on models marked tool-capable above.
- No embeddings, images, audio, files, batches or fine-tuning endpoints exist.
- Prompts are not stored by the gateway. Prompts are processed by Cloudflare Workers AI,
  or by Groq under the user's account when a Groq key is connected.
- Users manage keys, usage and their Groq key at https://htmltools.me/AI-API/Dashboard/
  using a Firebase account from project `general-database-4cb1c`.
- If every account endpoint answers 503 not_configured, the deployment is incomplete: the
  body lists exactly which binding or secret is missing. GET /health reports the same.
- Keys are shown at creation and can be viewed again by their owner after re-entering their
  Firebase password (or Google popup) within a 5-minute freshness window. Revocation is immediate.

## Minimal request

curl https://htmltools-me-ai-api.bozhetarnikmatthew.workers.dev/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ht-YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"@cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
